text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Qatar Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani starts on Thursday two-day official visit to Tunis to reinforce cooperation.
- Final phase of 9th developpment plan 1997-2001 adopted in a cabinet meeting chaired by President Ben Ali on Wednesday.
- Environment Minister Mohamed Mehdi Mlika and Greenpeace Tunisie launch campaign to promote ecological refrigerators "Greenfreeze".
- 103,128 candidates start national secondary school examination giving university entrance qualification.
- Second international motor exhibition to be held in Tunis from June 7-15.
- Tunisia and Portugal aim to boost bilateral economic cooperation.
